data.title: 平冢静 · 晨光厨房男友衬衫的完美人妻
data.description: 早晨阳光洒满厨房灶台，平冢静身上仅穿着你宽大的白色衬衫，纽扣随意系着两颗，露出修长紧致的美腿。一边煎着荷包蛋一边被你从身后抱住揉捏腰腹，她脸颊绯红回头，绽放出梦幻般的人妻笑容。
data.action: standing at kitchen stove in partner oversized unbuttoned white shirt, pinned against counter from behind while flipping eggs, blushing sweetly with a radiant wife smile
data.lighting: crisp morning sun pouring across counter and bare tanned legs
data.mood: ultimate dream housewife fulfillment, cozy morning post-sex bliss, pure companion joy
data.promptProse: Standing at the stove in an oversized unbuttoned white shirt, Shizuka Hiratsuka smiles with radiant newlywed bliss as partner hugs her from behind in morning sun.
